sources.title: NanoPower P80 Datasheet
sources.location: Printed pp. 1–23 (PDF pp. 8–30). Tables 1.1–1.2 pp. 5–6. Table 2.2 pp. 7–8. Table 4.1 p. 22.

supportedConfigurations: Configuration 1 only: 1×PMU, 1×ACU, 1×PDU in enclosure. ACU has 12 PV inputs in two banks of six MPPT boost converters.

selectedCatalogEntries.accountingBoundary: One complete configuration-1 assembly including PMU, ACU, PDU, enclosure and internal electronics. All conditioning/distribution/processor allocations reference this same physical usage and contribute its 0.3608 kg once. BP8 battery, external harness, mating connectors and spacecraft mounting are separate.
caveats: Canonical level board represents a multi-board enclosed assembly here, not a single PCB. Configuration 1 must remain fixed for these physical values.
The datasheet explicitly excludes BP8 from the P80 EPS boundary (printed p. 2). Do not add a battery role or battery capacity to P80.
25 V PV input maximum is distinct from the additional Voc < max(VBAT) condition. No minimum/startup/tracking envelope or aggregate input-power limit is inferred.
Regulator efficiency is supplied as typical curves versus load and battery voltage, not one guaranteed system efficiency. No scalar is adopted.
MCUs and watchdogs are explicit. MCU model, memory, compute headroom and firmware release/timing evidence are missing. No independent software role is claimed.
